homepage.title: @:name
homepage.subtitle: A collection of various assets for use within Beat Saber.

verified.title: This asset has been verified by the ModelSaber team and is safe to use!
verified.description: Verified assets have been checked for malware and are safe to use. Look for the green checkmark!

unverified.title: This asset has not been verified by the ModelSaber team. Use at your own risk!
unverified.description: Unverified assets have not been checked for malware. Be cautious when downloading and using these assets. @:assets.statusHover.verified.description

assets.nsfwWarning: This asset is marked as NSFW.

preview.noAudioSupport: Your browser does not support the audio element.
preview.noPreviewAvailable: No preview available for this asset.
preview.textOnlySr: This preview only shows the content within the file. If you wish to read it, please download the file and open it with your system.

approvalDialog.title: Update Status for {name}
approvalDialog.description: Select the new status for the asset "{name}". Click save to apply the changes.
approvalDialog.reasonWillBeVisible: This reason will be visible to the author of {name}.

downloadDialog.title: Download Unverified Asset?
downloadDialog.description: The asset you are trying to download has not been verified by the ModelSaber team. Unverified assets may contain malware or other harmful content. Are you sure you want to proceed with the download?
downloadDialog.neverShowAgain: If you'd like to never see this warning again, please click the "Don't show again" button.

reportDialog.title: Report {name}
reportDialog.description: If you believe this asset violates our community guidelines or contains inappropriate content, please provide a reason for reporting it. Our moderation team will review the report and take appropriate action if necessary.
reportDialog.reasonPlaceholder: Enter reason for reporting this asset

linkAssetDialog.title: Add a Related Asset
linkAssetDialog.description: Link another asset as related to this one by entering the link to the asset's page below.

altFormat.title: Alternative Format
altFormat.description: Same asset in a different file format (e.g. a saber in the .saber and .wacker formats)

altDesign.title: Alternative Design
altDesign.description: A different design or version of the same asset (e.g. a saber with a different color scheme or model)

newerVersion.title: Newer Version
newerVersion.description: A more recent version of the asset, typically with improvements or updates

olderVersion.title: Older Version
olderVersion.description: A previous version of of the asset released before the current one
